name: Oak Leaf Restaurant, Gourmet Deli & Coffee Bar
address: 168 Duthie Dr, Belvidere Estate, Knysna, 6571, South Africa
description_short: Estate dining with artisan deli and coffee bar on Knysna's Belvidere waterfront.
description_long:
Tucked into the Belvidere Estate alongside the Knysna Lagoon, Oak Leaf combines a relaxed restaurant, gourmet deli, and specialty coffee bar under one roof. The setting is leafy and tranquil, with views across the water and a menu that shifts between hearty breakfasts, deli-style lunches, and evening plates built around seasonal ingredients. The kitchen turns out proper wood-fired pizzas, generous salads, and daily specials that lean on local suppliers.

The attached deli stocks artisan breads, cured meats, and pantry staples worth browsing before you leave. Coffee is taken seriously, and the outdoor seating makes the most of Knysna's temperate weather. It's a welcoming spot for families, couples, and anyone after honest food in a genuinely peaceful corner of the Garden Route.
